26865-the-corsair-king.title: The Corsair King
26865-the-corsair-king.creator: Unknown
26865-the-corsair-king.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. the voice of an officer taking soundings, echoed on the air. At last the captain's finger stopped on a group of islands and he said quietly: "We are off the Ladrones." At the same moment a sailor on the mast-head shouted: "Land!" Without the slightest change of expression, the captain repeated: "The Ladrones."

arxiv-2112-07231.title: Bethe-Heitler signature in proton synchrotron models for gamma-ray bursts
arxiv-2112-07231.creator: D. Bégué, F. Samuelsson, A. Pe’er
arxiv-2112-07231.description: Abstract We study the effect of Bethe-Heitler (BeHe) pair production on a proton synchrotron model for the prompt emission in gamma-ray bursts (GRBs). The possible parameter space of the model is constrained by consideration of the synchrotron radiation from the secondary BeHe pairs. We find two regimes of interest.

arxiv-2203-05728.title: Snowmass2021 CMB-HD White Paper
arxiv-2203-05728.creator: The CMB-HD Collaboration, Simone Aiola, Yashar Akrami, Kaustuv Basu, Michael Boylan-Kolchin, Thejs Brinckmann, Sean Bryan, Caitlin M Casey, Jens Chluba, Sébastien Clesse, Francis-Yan Cyr-Racine, Luca Di Mascolo, Simon Dicker, Thomas Essinger-Hileman, Gerrit S. Farren, Michael A. Fedderke, Simone Fer
arxiv-2203-05728.description: Abstract CMB-HD is a proposed millimeter-wave survey over half the sky that would be ultra-deep (0.5 μ \mu K-arcmin) and have unprecedented resolution (15 arcseconds at 150 GHz). Such a survey would answer many outstanding questions about the fundamental physics of the Universe. Major advances would be 1.

arxiv-2208-03246.title: Non-Asymptotic Analysis of Ensemble Kalman Updates: Effective Dimension and Localization
arxiv-2208-03246.creator: Omar Al Ghattas* and Daniel Sanz-Alonso
arxiv-2208-03246.description: Abstract Many modern algorithms for inverse problems and data assimilation rely on ensemble Kalman updates to blend prior predictions with observed data. Ensemble Kalman methods often perform well with a small ensemble size, which is essential in applications where generating each particle is costly.

arxiv-2209-07144.title: Domain Adversarial Training on Conditional Variational Auto-Encoder for Controllable Music Generation
arxiv-2209-07144.description: Abstract The variational auto-encoder has become a leading framework for symbolic music generation, and a popular research direction is to study how to effectively control the generation process. A straightforward way is to control a model using different conditions during inference.

arxiv-2212-14148.title: Neutron capture-induced nuclear recoils as background for CEνNS measurements at reactors Preprint: August 9, 2026
arxiv-2212-14148.creator: A.J. Biffl, A. Gevorgian, K. Harris, A.N. Villano
arxiv-2212-14148.description: Abstract Nuclear reactors represent a promising neutrino source for CEνNS (coherent-elastic neutrino-nucleus scattering) searches. However, reactor sites also come with high ambient neutron flux. Neutron capture-induced nuclear recoils can create a spectrum that strongly overlaps the CEνNS signal for recoils ≲ \lesssim 100 eV for nuclear reactor measurements in silicon or germanium detectors.

arxiv-2401-02286.title: SFY — A lightweight, high-frequency and phase-resolving wave-buoy for coastal waters
arxiv-2401-02286.description: Abstract Small lightweight wave buoys, SFYs, designed to operate near the coast, have been developed. The buoys are designed to record and transmit the full time series of surface acceleration at 52 52 Hz. The buoy uses the cellular network to transfer data and position (up to 80 80 km from the base station). This reduces costs and increases band-width.

arxiv-2506-12050.title: Stackification via adjunction
arxiv-2506-12050.creator: Wei Zheng
arxiv-2506-12050.description: Abstract We establish a form of 2-adjunction (tentatively termed the *fundamental 2-adjunction*), building on the fundamental adjunction proposed by Olivia Caramello and Riccardo Zanfa, which provides a constructive method for the associated stack functor. Additionally, we investigate 2-local homeomorphisms through the lens of indexed fibrations.

arxiv-2506-13758.title: AI reconstruction of European weather from the Euro-Atlantic regimes
arxiv-2506-13758.creator: A. Camilletti \corrauth, G. Franch, E. Tomasi and M. Cristoforetti
arxiv-2506-13758.description: Abstract We present a non-linear AI-model designed to reconstruct monthly mean anomalies of the European temperature and precipitation based on the Euro-Atlantic WR ( WR ) indices. WR represent recurrent, quasi-stationary, and persistent states of the atmospheric circulation that exert considerable influence over the European weather, therefore offering an opportunity for sub-seasonal to seasonal forecasting.

arxiv-2512-19175.title: DESI DR2 Constraints on the R h = c ​ t R_{h}=ct Universe: Model Viability and Comparison with Λ \Lambda CDM
arxiv-2512-19175.creator: Amritansh Mehrotra, S. K. J. Pacif, A. F. Santos
arxiv-2512-19175.description: Abstract We carry out a comparative analysis of the standard Λ \Lambda CDM cosmological model and the alternative R h = c ​ t R_{h}=ct framework using recent observational data from cosmic chronometers, Type Ia supernova, and baryon acoustic oscillations.

europmc-pmc3282307.creator: Kelso JA.
europmc-pmc3282307.description: Multistable coordination dynamics exists at many levels, from multifunctional neural circuits in vertebrates and invertebrates to large-scale neural circuitry in humans. Moreover, multistability spans (at least) the domains of action and perception, and has been found to place...

pmc-10624263.title: Exploring fraity and sarcopenia in older adults admitted to acute medical unit, looking at prevalence, trajectory, and outcomes: A protocol testing the feasibility and acceptability of the TYSON study
pmc-10624263.creator: Vicky Kamwa, Thomas Jackson, Zaki Hassan-Smith, Elizabeth Sapey
pmc-10624263.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). BackgroundFrailty and sarcopenia are common in older people and are associated with adverse outcomes including increased mortality and morbidity. It is unclear whether screening for frailty and sarcopenia would identify specific populations most at risk of poor outcomes during unplanned hospital admissions, which screening tools should be used and what the trajectory of both conditions are over the course of an admission.

pmc-10698549.title: Global birth prevalence of Robin sequence in live-born infants: a systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-10698549.creator: Marie Wright, Mario Cortina-Borja, Rachel Knowles, Don S. Urquhart
pmc-10698549.description: Robin sequence (RS), a congenital disorder of jaw maldevelopment and glossoptosis, poses a substantial healthcare burden and has long-term health implications if airway obstruction is suboptimally treated. This study describes the global birth prevalence of RS and investigates whether prevalence estimates differ by geographical location, ethnicity or study data source (registry versus non-registry data).

pmc-11315023.title: An Application of Uncertainty Quantification to Efficiency Measurements and Validating Requirements through Correlating Simulation and Physical Testing Results †
pmc-11315023.creator: Michael Leighton, Uday Akasapu, Omprakash Kaiwartya
pmc-11315023.description: Validation is a critical aspect of product development for meeting design goals and mitigating risk in the face of considerable cost and time commitments. In this research article, uncertainty quantification (UQ) for efficiency testing of an Electric Drive Unit (EDU) is demonstrated, considering confidence in simulations with respect to the validation campaign.

pmc-11442299.title: Cardiac rehabilitation and secondary prevention of CVD: time to think about cardiovascular health rather than rehabilitation
pmc-11442299.creator: Julie Redfern, Robyn Gallagher, Andrew Maiorana, Dion Candelaria, Matthew Hollings, Sarah Gauci, Adrienne O’Neil, Georgia K. Chaseling, Ling Zhang, Emma E. Thomas, Gabriela L. M. Ghisi, Irene Gibson, Karice Hyun, Alexis Beatty, Tom Briffa, Rod S. Taylor, Ross Arena, Catriona Jennings, David Wood, Sh
pmc-11442299.description: During the past century, there have been major developments in the medical and surgical treatment of cardiovascular disease (CVD). These advancements have resulted in more people surviving initial events and having reduced length of stay in hospital; consequently, there is an increasing number of people in need of ongoing and lifelong cardiovascular risk management.

pmc-11673437.title: Effect of growing environment on the antioxidant activity of recultivated pea seedlings (Pisum sativum L.)
pmc-11673437.creator: Yuki Tsuruoka, Takahiro Hosoya
pmc-11673437.description: Pea seedlings (Pisum sativum L.) are young pea plants with the potential for sustainable cultivation; these plants are cost‐effective and provide high nutritional value. Although numerous studies have explored the nutritional content and functionality of pea seedlings, a few reports exist on the regrowth of pea seedlings after the initial harvest of their edible parts.

pmc-12390636.title: Aflatoxin Exposure in Immunocompromised Patients: Current State and Future Perspectives
pmc-12390636.creator: Temitope R. Fagbohun, Queenta Ngum Nji, Viola O. Okechukwu, Oluwasola A. Adelusi, Lungani A. Nyathi, Patience Awong, Patrick B. Njobeh
pmc-12390636.description: Aflatoxins (AFs), harmful secondary metabolites produced by the genus Aspergillus, particularly Aspergillus flavus and Aspergillus parasiticus, are one of the best-known potent mycotoxins, posing a significant risk to public health. The primary type, especially aflatoxin B1 (AFB1), is a potent carcinogen associated with liver cancer, immunosuppression, and other health problems.

pmc-13077859.title: Parental income in childhood and health outcomes across age groups: a register-based study from Norway
pmc-13077859.creator: Bjørn-Atle Reme, Hans Fredrik Sunde, Fartein Ask Torvik, Jonas Minet Kinge, Bjørn Heine Strand, Jonathan Wörn
pmc-13077859.description: BackgroundParental socioeconomic status is associated with health outcomes across age. However, the specific age-, gender-, and disease-related patterns linking parental income during early childhood to healthcare utilization across age remain poorly characterized. Enhanced understanding of these associations is essential to inform targeted interventions and improve health equity.

pmc-13312635.title: Mechanistically informed circulating biomarkers are associated with acquired epilepsy after neonatal brain injury
pmc-13312635.creator: Adam L Numis, Renée A Shellhaas, Janet S Soul, Marisa A Gardner, Courtney J Wusthoff, Giulia M Benedetti, Clara Di Germanio, Theo K Bammler, David J Erle, Walter L Eckalbar, Charles E McCulloch, Patrick J Heagerty, Thomas R Wood, Yvonne W Wu, Sandra E Juul, Daniel H Lowenstein, Hannah C Glass, the N
pmc-13312635.description: BackgroundAcute provoked neonatal seizures are a major risk factor for acquired epilepsy, yet clinicians lack reliable tools to identify neonates at highest risk. Preclinical data implicate innate immune activation and neuronal injury as key drivers of epileptogenesis, suggesting blood-based biomarkers could provide mechanistic insight and prognostic utility.
